jobText:
Role: Frontend Software Engineer
Location: Austin, TX / Remote

Overview:
We are seeking a Frontend Software Engineer with 1-3 years of experience to join our core product team. You will build intuitive web interfaces that power our cloud collaboration platform.

Responsibilities:
- Develop performant, reusable UI components using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind CSS).
- Collaborate with UX designers and backend engineers to translate product specs into production features.
- Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to guarantee product stability.
- Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and architectural discussions.

Qualifications:
- 1+ years of professional web development experience with React and TypeScript.
- Solid understanding of web standards, responsive design, and browser rendering mechanics.
- Experience with automated testing frameworks (Jest, Vitest, or Playwright).
- Familiarity with state management libraries and RESTful API integration.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
